messages:
oncall-bot: Incident alert -> P1: hosted-api throughput spike detected at 1745121200. Page sent to @Alex. Root cause candidate: KV cache pressure on gpu-host-23. Auto-mitigation applied (scale + cache flush). Incident resolved at 1745122022. Short summary: transient queueing increased latency and dropped some requests.

Alex: Thanks for the summary. I want two things: 1) schedule a postmortem with RCA, 2) update the on-call runbook + paging rules so this is less noisy. Who can own the RCA?

Maria: I can take the RCA and the runbook edits. I'll draft the postmortem and schedule a 45m follow-up.

Sanjay: I'll pick up the technical mitigation steps for the runtime (KV cache behaviour). Need the exact timeline of the cache pressure to reproduce. Maria, can you add log ranges?

Maria: Yep, adding logs + timeline to the doc. Quick notes from logs: spike began ~1745121165, queue growth seen on gpu-host-23 from 1745121180 to ~1745121980, cache eviction thrashing observed 1745121200-1745121500.

Jamie: We also had several alerts fire that felt like duplicates. Can we standardize dedupe windows and severity mapping in the playbook? Paging too often wakes up people for the same root cause.

OpsManager: Absolutely. Let's track concrete action items here and owners + due dates. I'll own the follow-up tracking.

Alex: Action list draft: 
- Maria: RCA + postmortem doc + meeting (owner) — due: 3 business days.
- Sanjay: Runbook section for KV cache pressure mitigation (runbook steps + commands) — due: 2 business days.
- Jamie: Propose paging threshold changes and dedupe policy (alert rules) — due: 2 business days.
- OpsManager: Create tickets, add to sprint, verify rollout of changes — due: 1 week.

Maria: Adding the postmortem template now. I'll include timeline, impact, mitigation, root cause analysis, and follow-ups. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/1745123456 (I'll update after initial draft). :pencil2:

Sanjay: Proposed runbook mitigation steps (will add to doc):
1) Detect sustained queue growth on any inference node > 2m.
2) Execute cache-soft-flush: 
```bash
# soft flush: instruct workers to drop LRU entries
redwoodctl cache flush --grace 30s --scope=worker
```
3) If queue length > 500 for any host: remove host from load-balancer and scale pool:
```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=0 --selector=host=gpu-host-23
# wait 30s
kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=5
```
4) Notify customer-impact channel and update incident status.

Maria: Also adding a short checklist at the top of the runbook: 
- Who is IC, who is comms, who is SRE support.
- Quick triage commands and safe mitigation snippets.

Jamie: Proposed paging escalation tweak:
- Alert -> page primary on-call (P0/P1)
- If not acknowledged in 3m -> page secondary (sms + phone)
- If not acknowledged in 10m -> page manager + incident leader
- Add dedupe window: suppress duplicate alerts for same host/metric for 5m after first page.

Jamie: Example alert config snippet I'll propose: 
```yaml
- name: hosted-api-high-rt
  severity: page
  condition: latency.p95 > 800ms for 2m
  dedupe_window: 300s
  escalation: [primary, secondary, manager]
```

Alex: That looks good. Also, let's add an explicit handoff procedure: when IC rotates, they must post a one-line handoff message in #eng-oncall with status, what mitigations are active, and outstanding tasks. Handoff should include expected check-in time.

OpsManager: I'll add an item to the on-call checklist: 
- IC handoff template: 
  - current status
  - active mitigations
  - outstanding action items
  - next check-in time

Maria: Scheduling: I booked a 45m postmortem for Fri 14:00 PT. Draft RCAs will be ready ahead of time. Invite list: IC, oncall, runtime owners, product PM.

Sanjay: Small note — we should add a mitigation toggle to the console to temporarily disable scheduling new requests to a host. Will file a request in infra backlog.

Jamie: I'll update alerting playbook and send a PR to observability repo with the dedupe changes. Will include tests that simulate repeated alerts.

Alex: For tracking: OpsManager please open a single umbrella ticket and sub-tasks for each action. Put links to PRs and runbook pages there.

OpsManager: Created ticket: OPS-1234 (https://issues.redwood.internal/OPS-1234) — added sub-tasks for RCA (Maria), Runbook (Sanjay), Alerts (Jamie). I'll update owners and due dates. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Action items added to OPS-1234: Maria (RCA), Sanjay (Runbook), Jamie (Alerts). Reminders set for 48h.

Maria: Quick customer-impact note: we saw a small % of 5xx for 12 minutes affecting one enterprise customer — I'm adding a note to the postmortem and will contact support to confirm status.

Alex: Good. Let's also add a short blameless wording to the runbook intro and postmortem. Keep it focused on systems and process improvements.

Sanjay: I'll open the runbook PR and tag @Alex and @Maria for review.

Jamie: PR for alert dedupe will reference OPS-1234. Will include unit tests for dedupe logic.

OpsManager: I'll follow up after the postmortem meeting to check progress. If anyone needs help, ping me.

Alex: Thanks team — appreciate the quick response and follow-up. Closing thread for now, will reopen if more info shows up.

oncall-bot: Thread closed by Alex. If new updates arrive they will append here.
